title: Exact derived localization preserves pasting of noninvertible transformations
statement: Let a finite diagram of abelian categories with chosen ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] be given. Label its edges by additive exact functors and its cells by natural transformations between composites of edges; these transformations need not be invertible. Write $C(F)$ for degreewise application and choose $D(F)$ with the standard factorization $D(F)Q\simeq QC(F)$ of [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. For $t:F_2F_1\to H_2H_1$, define $t^D:D(F_2)D(F_1)\to D(H_2)D(H_1)$ as inverse exact-composition comparison, localization of $C(t)$, and forward exact-composition comparison. Derive each specified compositor isomorphism in the same way. Then every equality between finite composites and whiskerings of these cells and compositors passes to the corresponding equality on unbounded derived categories. In particular both vertical and horizontal square-pasting equations, naturality equations, and compositor unit equations pass with these precise comparisons. Invertible ordinary cells induce invertible derived cells; no resolution, boundedness assumption or faithfulness of an evaluation functor is needed.

source.place: Tag 015F (lemma-right-derived-exact-functor); exact unbounded localization of possibly noninvertible square cells; agent proof using exact derived factorization and the localization universal property

proof.text: For a word P, let a_P be Q whiskered by the inverse of P.comparison, followed by the standard factorization of the single ordinary exact functor. This is an isomorphism Q ⋙ P.derived ≅ C(P) ⋙ Q. The cochain representative formula for mapDerivedCategoryIdIso gives a_nil = 1. Expanding Word.comparison, using the normalized compositor factorization, cancelling its inverse and using naturality twice gives a_comp(P,R),K = R.derived.map(a_P,K) ≫ a_R,C(P)K. These calculations are wordFactors_nil and wordFactors_comp.

The component formula for Localization.liftNatTrans and cancellation of the word comparisons give cell_factors: cell(α) at Q(K), followed by a_R,K, equals a_P,K followed by Q(C(α)_K). The localization lifting isomorphisms here are definitionally the exact functor factorization isomorphisms.

Induct on Expression to prove expression_factors, the same component normalization for the derived evaluation of an arbitrary expression. Identities and vertical composition follow from functoriality of degreewise application and Q. For input whiskering, expand the two composite word factorizations and use naturality of the already derived cell at a_U,K, then its induction hypothesis at C(U)K. This uses an actual derived morphism, without assuming it lifts to a complex morphism. For output whiskering, apply the output derived functor to the induction hypothesis and use naturality of the output word factorization at C(α)_K.

In the associator and inverse-associator cases, degreewise ordinary associators have identity components. Expanding the two composite word factorizations reduces their normalization to preservation of composition by the last derived functor and associativity. In all four unitor cases, degreewise unitors have identity components; use a_nil = 1, the composite formula, and preservation of identities. Thus empty words and both directions of each structural cell are included in the same induction.

Compare expression_factors and cell_factors, cancel the invertible target word factorization, and apply Localization.natTrans_ext at Q. This gives e.derived = cell(e.ordinary). Rewriting by this identity proves that equal ordinary evaluations have equal derived evaluations.

For invertible α, the localized transformation in Word.cell is definitionally the hom of Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso (asIso α), itself defined using Localization.liftNatIso. It is invertible, and composing with the invertible word comparisons preserves invertibility. This proves the final clause for arbitrary unbounded complexes.

proof_origin.place: Tag 015F together with categories.tex Tag 04VG; formal component-normalization proof by F6, using Mathlib Localization.liftNatTrans/natTrans_ext, the existing exact derived compositor normalization, and the proved cochain identity-comparison formula in lem-pur-exact-restriction-composition.

lean.statement: theorem exact_derived_transformation_pasting [Finite I] : (∀ {i j : I} {P R : Word C i j} (e : Expression C P R), e.derived = Word.cell C e.ordinary) ∧ (∀ {i j : I} {P R : Word C i j} (e f : Expression C P R), e.ordinary = f.ordinary → e.derived = f.derived) ∧ (∀ {i j : I} {P R : Word C i j} (α : P.ordinary.obj ⟶ R.ordinary.obj), IsIso α → IsIso (Word.cell C α))
